PRIVACY_PAGE.TITLE: PRIVACY POLICY
PRIVACY_PAGE.SEC1_DESC: We collect only the essential data required to provide our AI-driven contract analysis services. All uploaded documents are temporarily stored in volatile memory and are permanently expunged post-analysis.
PRIVACY_PAGE.SEC2_DESC: Your legal documents are strictly confidential. We do not use your contracts to train our models unless explicitly opted-in by the enterprise administrator.
PRIVACY_PAGE.SEC3_DESC: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or corporate data to third parties. Our infrastructure operates on secure, isolated instances.
PRIVACY_PAGE.SEC4_DESC: Our platform adheres to GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type II standards to ensure maximum security and privacy.

TERMS_PAGE.TITLE: TERMS OF SERVICE
TERMS_PAGE.SEC1_DESC: By accessing LEX.AUDIT, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our platform.
TERMS_PAGE.SEC2_DESC: The AI analysis provided by LEX.AUDIT does not constitute formal legal advice. We are not liable for any damages or losses arising from reliance on the automated risk assessments.
TERMS_PAGE.SEC3_DESC: API abuse, automated scraping, or attempts to reverse engineer the auditing models will result in immediate termination of the service account.

COOKIE_PAGE.TITLE: COOKIE POLICY
COOKIE_PAGE.SEC1_DESC: We use essential cookies required for the platform to function securely, such as authentication tokens and session identifiers. These cannot be disabled.
COOKIE_PAGE.SEC2_DESC: We employ minimal tracking to understand performance bottlenecks. No personally identifiable information is tracked in this process.
COOKIE_PAGE.SEC3_DESC: You can manage or delete cookies via your browser settings. However, doing so may degrade the application's performance and security features.
